title: no-spec-step-typo fails one run in three
what: no-spec-step-typo fails one run in three
why: Measured 27 Oct: the plugin eval case no-spec-step-typo failed 1 of 3 runs in both wave paid runs that day: at 9bc988d run 3 (code grader no-openspec-command), at aa8cfd1 run 1 (code grader worker-started); 2 of its last 6 runs, each on a different grader; every other case passed. The traces are deleted after each run (item a-red-paid-run-keeps-no-traces-to-find-its-cause), so the cause is unknown: model behaviour on a typo prompt, or graders that are too strict. Principle 6: a repeat failure is a cause to find, not a rerun.
failing_case: Run the case no-spec-step-typo 6 times with traces kept: at least one run fails worker-started or no-openspec-command.
pass_cases: The cause is named from a kept trace (what the session did, which grader judged it, whether the grader was right).
Fixed at the cause (skill text or grader), with the grader shown to fail a wrong call.
6 of 6 runs pass after the fix.
